baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of believing, working, and sound deeds, followed by continuously running provision.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust becomes intentional practice; soundness specifies what that practice produces, and ongoing provision answers it with a durable rather than momentary good.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust supplies the inward stability that practice can embody.
Intentional doing makes the transition from inward trust to enacted conduct.
Soundness opposed to corruption defines the work by its repairing effect.
Ongoing provision turns the result into sustained support rather than a single payment.

changed_reading.before: Belief plus good deeds receives a pleasant reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled trust is made operative as repairing practice and answered by a continuously sustaining order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Covered gardens, flowing channels below them, and the naming of the whole as great fawz.
baseline_models.mechanism: The waterless peril carried by the fawz inventory makes victory a successful passage: running water cuts open the ground and arrives within a tree-covered destination where lack has been reversed.

activation_trace.role: A garden concealed by trees supplies the protected destination of the passage.
Literal running and flowing supplies motion through and beyond peril.
A river cutting earth with flowing water materially reverses the waterless route.
The desert passage poised between escape and destruction supplies the risk-bearing shape of victory.

changed_reading.before: The great victory is possession of gardens.
changed_reading.after: The great victory is the completed crossing from lethal scarcity into concealed, water-fed life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Security, concealment, protection, below-ness, and opened flow coexist in the focus wording.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden can be read as a topology of inward safety: a guarded, hidden interior is not sealed shut, because channels beneath it remain open and life-bearing.

activation_trace.role: Settled security supplies the affective interior of the model.
The heart concealed in the chest moves garden concealment into an inward register.
Protective covering makes hiddenness sheltering rather than merely invisible.
Literal underneath locates support below the protected visible surface.
Opening and widening until flow occurs prevents protection from becoming confinement.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are only an external destination.
changed_reading.after: The gardens also model guarded inward life whose hidden supports remain open and circulating.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Work, suitable soundness, possession marked by 'for them,' and a victory described as great.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of wage and human dealing make the outcome resemble a fitting settlement of practiced relations; suitability links the character of the work to the character of its result.

activation_trace.role: Pay for work supplies the settlement analogy.
Dealing between people makes action relational rather than an isolated score.
Fitness or suitability links the deed and its fitting outcome.
Winning good and escaping harm names the favorable settlement.
The chief share or bulk of an affair makes the settlement comprehensive.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are a detached bonus added after deeds.
changed_reading.after: The outcome is a comprehensive and fitting settlement continuous with the kind of work practiced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening height and fortified elevations activate the focus verse as layered counter-architecture: a shading, protected canopy above and moving water below replace a flat picture of luxury.

activation_trace.role: What rises and shades supplies the upper protective layer of the spatial model.
Fortified towers contribute durable enclosure rather than decorative height.
The tree-covered garden anchors the upper layer in the focus image.
Underneath supplies the lower coordinate of the layered habitat.
Earth-cut watercourses make the lower layer active infrastructure.

structural_cues: 85:1 pairs a shading height with fortified elevations, while 85:11 explicitly locates moving water below a covered garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: elevation, shade, fortification, concealment, and below-ground flow. Reader arrow: these form one vertically organized refuge. Live alternative: the opening images may signal cosmic grandeur without specifying the garden's architecture.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a scenic reward containing rivers.
changed_reading.after: The garden is a vertically organized refuge, defended and shaded above while sustaining channels work below.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise and witnessed presence strengthen the focus-only wage model: confirmation, work, and favorable outcome become a settlement whose fulfillment is publicly verifiable.

activation_trace.role: A spoken promise that opens hope supplies the commitment awaiting fulfillment.
Presence with seeing turns fulfillment into an inspectable event.
Trusting confirmation anchors the response to the promised report.
The wage image gives the promised result a settlement structure.
Winning good and escape supplies the content of the fulfilled settlement.

structural_cues: The promised day is immediately followed by witness and witnessed before the focus verse states what is 'for them.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: promise, presence with seeing, confirmation, wage, and outcome. Reader arrow: the witnesses verify fulfillment of the promise. Live alternative: witness and witnessed may mark the day generally, not a settlement scene.

changed_reading.before: The outcome is privately enjoyed compensation.
changed_reading.after: The outcome is the visible fulfillment of a trusted promise, settled before witnesses rather than hidden from history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trench and the river are rival uses of an earth-cut channel. One is supplied with fuel and flame under stationary surveillance; the other carries water beneath vigorous growth. The focus image materially reverses the persecutors' apparatus.

activation_trace.role: A deep longitudinal cut supplies the destructive channel that the focus watercourse reverses.
Kindled fire supplies the trench's destructive contents.
Fuel material makes destruction a maintained system rather than a passing flame.
Sitting in ambush or watch supplies the fixed human posture opposed by free flow.
A river cutting earth with water transforms the channel from instrument of death to conduit of life.
Continuous running opposes the watchers' fixed and controlling posture.
Thick vigorous growth is the living output of the transformed channel.

structural_cues: 85:4-6 sequences cut ground, fire, fuel, and seated watchers; 85:11 sequences covered growth, running, below-ness, and earth-cut water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two cut-ground systems with opposite materials, plus stationary watchers and running water. Reader arrow: the later channel is a deliberate material reversal of the earlier one. Live alternative: the verses may contrast punishment and reward broadly without making the channel engineering itself thematic.

changed_reading.before: The rivers simply decorate the reward after a fire scene.
changed_reading.after: The rivers answer the trench point for point: the persecutors' engineered channel of maintained fire becomes an uncontrollable channel of maintained life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The persecutors also produce actions and witness them. That context prevents 'worked' from meaning mere efficacy: the focus adds intentional work and soundness against corruption, distinguishing productive repair from successfully executed harm.

activation_trace.role: Bringing about an act supplies morally unspecified efficacy on the persecutors' side.
Presence with seeing shows that awareness alone does not make an action sound.
Rejecting and faulting identifies the social judgment imposed on the believers' trust.
Intentional work anchors the focus side as chosen practice, not bare occurrence.
Soundness against corruption supplies the criterion that separates the two kinds of doing.
Trusting assent identifies what the hostile social judgment cannot invalidate.

structural_cues: 85:7 foregrounds what the persecutors do and knowingly witness; 85:8 says their only objection is the believers' trust; 85:11 specifies work as sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an unqualified causing of action, aware witnesses, hostile faulting, then intentional and sound work. Reader arrow: the lexical shift discriminates actions by the worlds they make. Live alternative: the variation between doing and working may be stylistic rather than contrastive.

changed_reading.before: Believers are rewarded because they were active and morally good.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes effective harm from effective repair: action counts as sound work by what it makes inhabitable, not by force, visibility, or success alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch naming water as the mainstay of an affair, inside the declaration of dominion, activates the focus river system as the operating principle of a realm. Fertile earth and opened flow make the garden a functioning ecology, not real estate.

activation_trace.role: Water as the controlling mainstay of an affair supplies the causal hinge between dominion and the focus rivers.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receptive material on which the water-governed system acts.
Opening and widening until flow occurs makes water infrastructural.
Continuing provision identifies the realm's sustaining operation.
Vigorous plant growth is the visible yield of the water-governed system.

structural_cues: 85:9 names dominion over sky and earth; the focus verse immediately presents fertile growth organized around flowing water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: dominion, water as an affair's mainstay, fertile earth, opened channels, and continuing provision. Reader arrow: water is the realm's organizing medium. Live alternative: the water proverb may be lexically available without qualifying the dominion statement here.

changed_reading.before: The believers receive plots inside a sovereign's estate.
changed_reading.after: They enter a self-sustaining realm whose sovereignty is manifested as water made continuously available to fertile life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The metallurgy of testing by fire changes faith and sound work from untested virtues into integrity that has endured a furnace. Fawz as perilous passage then names emergence without allowing the ordeal to define the survivors' substance.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or a person supplies the test of whether inner composition holds.
Burning and blackening supplies the destructive material pressure of the test.
Flame makes the assay concrete rather than merely psychological.
Settled trust is the interior composition placed under pressure.
Soundness against corruption names integrity that the ordeal fails to spoil.
The passage between escape and destruction gives tested integrity an exit trajectory.

structural_cues: 85:10 places testing, believers, non-return, punishment, and burning immediately before the focus statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: assay, burning, settled trust, soundness, and dangerous passage. Reader arrow: endurance reveals rather than creates the believers' integrity. Live alternative: testing may denote persecution only, with no metallurgical claim about character.

changed_reading.before: Sound deeds precede reward without reference to how their soundness became visible.
changed_reading.after: The focus names integrity disclosed under destructive heat and a passage whose end proves that the furnace did not own its subjects.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nurturing completion, vine-trellising, pasture filled to sufficiency, and active making cluster around the focus garden. They activate it as cultivated commonwealth: protected abundance is tended and structured, not passively consumed.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply the governing mode of cultivation.
Trellising vines supplies the built support by which garden growth is trained.
Pasture and belly filled to sufficiency turns glory into ecological enoughness.
Active bringing-about keeps the cultivated order dynamic.
Manual labor crews make human work materially participatory in the cultivation image.
Dense vigorous growth supplies what nurture and trellising sustain.
Opened irrigation paths complete the material system.

structural_cues: 85:12-16 moves through lordship, beginning and return, loving cover, elevated structure, fullness, and active making around the focus garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: nurture, completion, vine support, sufficiency, action, labor, growth, and channels. Reader arrow: these images belong to one cultivated social ecology. Live alternative: throne and majesty retain royal senses, and the horticultural branches may be incidental here.

changed_reading.before: The blessed occupy a finished garden as consumers.
changed_reading.after: The garden is a tended commonwealth of repair, skilled support, enoughness, and participatory work.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning-again, return, protective covering, and love revise the one-way escape model. The garden becomes restored re-entry into life: concealment protects a fresh beginning, while continuing flow keeps restoration from being a single reset.

activation_trace.role: Beginning paired with return supplies a restart rather than an isolated origin.
Return after departure gives victory a restorative trajectory.
A covering that protects supplies the shelter under which restart can survive.
Love and affection give restoration a relational cause rather than a mechanical cycle.
A thing at its fresh beginning anchors restart inside the focus garden root.
Protective cover joins garden concealment to the context's sheltering cover.
Ongoing provision makes restored life durable after its fresh beginning.
The dangerous passage remains present, but now ends in return and renewal.

structural_cues: Immediately after the focus, severity is followed by beginning, return, forgiving cover, and love.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: beginning-with-return, protective cover, love, fresh growth, and ongoing supply. Reader arrow: these cause the garden to function as restorative re-entry. Live alternative: beginning and return may refer to resurrection generally, while forgiveness and love remain separate attributes.

changed_reading.before: Victory is a one-way exit from peril into a static destination.
changed_reading.after: Victory is loving restoration: life is begun again, returned under protection, and kept flowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Late context distinguishes concealments by effect. Denial covers truth and hides it behind appearances, then finds itself enclosed; the focus garden also covers, but as a shield around opened flow. One cover suppresses, the other shelters life.

activation_trace.role: Covering truth supplies the suppressive form of concealment.
Putting something behind the visible back supplies concealment by appearance.
Encompassing conquest or destruction turns the concealer into the enclosed.
Covering and concealment anchors the comparison inside the focus garden.
Protective cover differentiates sheltering concealment from truth suppression.
Opening until flow occurs proves that the garden's cover is permeable to life.

structural_cues: 85:19-20 places denial inside ongoing falsification and then depicts an enclosure arriving from behind; the focus garden is earlier defined by cover plus open flow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: truth-covering, hiding behind appearance, destructive enclosure, protective cover, and opened flow. Reader arrow: effects morally distinguish two kinds of concealment. Live alternative: the shared cover imagery may be lexical coincidence without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: Garden concealment is only privacy and shade.
changed_reading.after: Garden concealment is an ethical inversion of denial: it protects without suppressing and encloses only so life can open and circulate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathered recitation, a written board, and persistent preservation reactivate the focus sequence as an operating pattern. Trust is put to work in a fitting way and becomes a course that keeps running; the garden reading can therefore be enacted as well as awaited.

activation_trace.role: A method, exemplar, or intended course supplies the pattern carried by the recited whole.
A broad writing board gives the pattern a durable material inscription.
Adherence and repeated maintenance make preservation operational rather than archival.
A habitual running course anchors repeatability in the focus wording.
Putting something to work converts the preserved pattern into practice.
Fitness for a purpose specifies whether the enacted pattern functions well.

structural_cues: The closing lines move from gathered recitation to inscription and preservation, after the focus has already presented a compact trust-work-soundness-flow sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exemplar or course, writing surface, maintained preservation, habitual flow, use, and fitness. Reader arrow: the focus sequence is one preserved pattern meant for re-enactment. Live alternative: the close may concern textual preservation only, with no metapractical claim about 85:11.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a distant destination and its eligibility conditions.
changed_reading.after: The verse also preserves a repeatable operating course: settled trust put to sound use already runs in the form of the promised world.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dominant fawz image is escape and gain, not death; it remains live because death is an explicit focus-root branch and the context explicitly kills, while garden concealment includes burial and fresh beginning. Downstream prose should present it as a paradoxical coexistence, never as the lexical translation of fawz in 85:11.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names fawz and a concealed garden whose inventory includes both burial and fresh beginning.

activation_trace.role: Killing and extinguishing life supplies the context pressure against a purely survivalist victory.
Death and perishing supplies the startling possibility that fawz can pass through what ordinarily looks like defeat.
Burial and shrouding gives concealment a death-facing threshold.
Fresh beginning carries the threshold beyond burial into renewed life.

changed_reading.before: Great victory means being spared from killing.
changed_reading.after: For the killed faithful, death may become a concealed threshold within victory rather than victory's cancellation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because 'under them' is spatial syntax, not a direct label for lowly people; it remains anchored in the exact focus roots for under-ness, honor, and escape. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social resonance of the vertical wording, not replace the literal river location with a status claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes under-ness with a victory described by a root that also carries rank and honor.

activation_trace.role: Lowly people supplies the social underside latent in the spatial word.
Rank, honor, and leadership supplies the elevated status at the other end of the reversal.
Escape and winning good supplies the movement from imposed lowliness into honor.

changed_reading.before: Underneath only locates the rivers, and great only magnifies the reward.
changed_reading.after: The vertical wording also resonates as status reversal: those treated as beneath others pass into durable honor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The trigger is a remote zoological branch of the denial root, so it cannot define takdhib here; it remains worth carrying because its exact image of running and then stopping directly perturbs the focus verb of running and its branch of ongoing provision. Downstream prose should mark this as a kinetic foil, not lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes uninterrupted running central to the garden's provision.

activation_trace.role: An animal that runs and then stops supplies the strange image of failed or non-durable motion.
Literal running and flowing anchors the kinetic comparison in the focus.
Ongoing provision makes continuity, rather than mere initial motion, the decisive feature.

changed_reading.before: The rivers run as a static convention of garden description.
changed_reading.after: Their unfailing course becomes a foil to denial's failed run: what is true and sustaining does not break stride.

strongest_changes: The fire trench and the water river became rival earth-cut systems, turning the focus into a material reversal rather than generic compensation.
The perpetrators' effective doing forced a distinction between action as mere efficacy and sound work as world-repair.
Beginning, return, protective cover, and love changed victory from one-way escape into sustained restoration.
Competing images of concealment distinguished truth-suppressing enclosure from the garden's permeable protection.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah repeatedly changed from a static reward statement into an operating counter-world: hidden yet open, protected yet flowing, cultivated rather than idle, and capable of carrying both escape and renewal without collapsing them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The trench-to-river engineering parallel is strong abductively but is not an explicit grammatical comparison.
Water as the mainstay of dominion and the trellised commonwealth depend on vivid cross-domain branches whose local senses may remain inactive.
The death branch of fawz is directly inventoried but may be only a lexical outlier in this construction.
The preserved operating-pattern reading may overextend the closing textual-preservation cues into ethics.
